mapper.sql: p.id, p.name, p.store_id, p.promo_type, p.start_time, p.end_time, p.discount_percent, p.threshold_amount, p.reduce_amount, p.currency, p.fee_amount, p.fee_base, p.budget, p.status, p.push_status, p.platform_promo_id, p.push_message, p.push_time, p.owner_id, p.remark, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_time, s.name AS store_name, s.platform, s.marketplace, u.nickname AS owner_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecom_promotion_item i WHERE i.promotion_id = p.id) AS item_count
FROM ecom_promotion p JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = p.store_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.owner_id
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(o.order_time AS DATE) AS "day", COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS "orders", COALESCE(SUM(oi.qty), 0) AS "qty", COALESCE(SUM(oi.amount * o.exchange_rate), 0) AS "sales", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.item_amount > 0 THEN o.profit * oi.amount / o.item_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "profit" FROM ecom_order_item oi JOIN ecom_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE GROUP BY CAST(o.order_time AS DATE) ORDER BY CAST(o.order_time AS DATE)

SELECT oi.seller_sku AS "sellerSku", MAX(oi.title) AS "title", COALESCE(SUM(oi.qty), 0) AS "qty", COALESCE(SUM(oi.amount * o.exchange_rate), 0) AS "sales" FROM ecom_order_item oi JOIN ecom_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE GROUP BY oi.seller_sku
